pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De ypocrisi (Socrates and a disciple)
pairs.question: Estne aliud genus ypocrisis, unde homini cavendum sit?
pairs.answer: Est homo qui in aperto et in occulto obedire se Deo ostendit, ut sanctus ab hominibus habeatur et ab eis ideo plus honoretur.
pairs.derivation: A disciple poses a genuine interrogative (Estne... ?) and Socrates answers it. Dropped the framing 'Dicit ei unus ex discipulis:' before the question and 'Dicit Socrates:' before the answer. Stripped the scaffolding section marker '[p. 3]' that fell mid-sentence in the answer (habeatur [p. 3] et ab eis). The answer ends at its first full stop ('...plus honoretur.'); what follows ('Est alius isto subtilior...') describes a further, subtler kind and is elaboration beyond the direct yes-and-here-it-is answer, so it was cut.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, I. Exemplum de dimidio amico (father and son)
pairs.question: Quomodo probare consulis?
pairs.answer: Vitulum interfectum et frustatim comminutum in sacco repone, ita ut saccus forinsecus sanguine infectus sit.
pairs.derivation: The son asks a real interrogative (Quomodo... ?) about how to test his friends, and the father answers with the concrete method. Dropped the framing 'Dixit filius:' and 'Dixit pater:'. The answer ends at its first full stop; what follows ('Et cum ad amicum veneris, dic ei...') continues the instructions and was cut.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De silentio (disciple and master)
pairs.question: Quomodo habendo me inter sapientes discipulos computabor?
pairs.answer: Serva silentium, donec sit tibi loqui necessarium.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De divitiis (disciple and master)
pairs.question: Laudas congregare pecuniam?
pairs.answer: Ita! Acquire, sed iuste et in bono dispende nec in thesauro reconde.
pairs.derivation: A genuine interrogative (Laudas... ?) directly answered. Dropped the framing 'Dispiculus magistro:' and 'Magister:'. The whole short reply is the answer (the emphatic 'Ita!' plus the qualification); nothing trimmed.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De benefacto (disciple and master)
pairs.question: Prohibuit philosophus benefactum denegare; sed non divisit benefactum creatoris vel creaturae?
pairs.answer: Dico tibi quod ille qui denegat benefactum, denegat Deum; et ille qui non obedit regi vel rectori, est inobediens Deo.
pairs.derivation: The disciple poses a real interrogative (sed non divisit... ?) and the master answers it. Kept the disciple's leading clause ('Prohibuit philosophus benefactum denegare;') as verbatim setup so the question's referent is intelligible. Dropped the framing 'Interrogavit discipulus magistrum suum:' and 'Ad haec magister:'. The answer ends at its first full stop; what follows ('Discipulus: Ostende mihi rationem...') is a fresh request and was cut.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De modo comedendi (son and father)
pairs.question: O pater, quare oblitus es dicere quomodo debet homo comedere coram rege?
pairs.answer: Non oblitus fui dicere, quia nulla differentia est inter comedere coram rege et alibi.
pairs.derivation: A genuine interrogative (quare... ?) answered directly. Dropped the framing 'Filius:' and 'Pater:'. The answer is the father's complete one-sentence reply; nothing trimmed.

pairs.question: Si quis invitaverit me ad prandium, quomodo respondebo: concedam statim annon?

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De modo comedendi (young man and old man, on how much to eat)

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De familiaritate regis / domus delitiarum (Arab son and father)
pairs.question: Quomodo domum delitiarum et gloriam eius lucrari potero?
pairs.answer: Quicquid melius et pretiosius habes, repone in ea custodiendum, et invenies cum illuc veneris tibi paratum.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De morte (son and father)
pairs.question: Mortis nexus aliquo modo fugere poterimus?
pairs.answer: Minime, quia illius incurabilis est morsus, nec medicis artibus eius avaras fugiemus manus.
pairs.derivation: A real interrogative (fugere poterimus?) answered directly. Dropped the framing 'Item filius:' and 'Pater:'. The answer is the father's complete one-sentence reply; nothing trimmed.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De morte (son and father, on enduring death)
pairs.question: Quomodo ergo ne nimis laedat sustinebimus?
pairs.answer: Fac sicut dicit versificator quidam: Quod vitare nequis constanti sustine mente! Sic quae dura fuit mors tibi mitis erit.
pairs.derivation: A genuine interrogative (Quomodo... sustinebimus?) answered by the father, who replies by quoting a versifier. Dropped the framing 'Filius:' and 'Pater:'. Kept the answer through the quoted couplet, which is the substance of the reply; the inline two-line verse is the author's own text. Nothing trimmed internally.

pairs.locus: Petrus Alfonsi, Disciplina Clericalis, De aliis heremitarum dictis (hermit and master)
pairs.question: Quid faciam in hoc saeculo, quod me praecedat in alio?
